test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the passage about?

options.text: Metro life and the subway facilities
The risky life in the subways

solution:
The correct answer is **"The risky life in the subways" .**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The writer has mentioned so many reasons as the **subway air pollution**.
 
• **Station depth, building date, ventilation method (natural or air-conditioned), train wheel material (rubber or steel), frequency of trains**, and, more recently, **the presence or absence of platform screen-door systems**, are essential elements that affect subway air pollution.
 
• However, **researchers'** findings that those working on **Stockholm's subway platforms**, where PM concentrations were highest, tended to have greater levels of risk markers for **cardiovascular disease** than ticket agents and train drivers, should be taken with a grain of salt.
 
• So we can say the passage is all about **the risky life in the subways**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There is mentioned nothing about the **facilities of subway workers and metro life**. Rather the risks are mentioned in the passage for the **subway workers**.
 
• Therefore, **option 1)** and **option 2) **are not the correct options because the **benefits of living in a subway** are stated in these two options.
 
• How **pollution is being spread by the railroad** is mentioned only in the second paragraph.
 
• Therefore, the rest of the three options are not appropriate for the given question.
